profile.headline: Fullstack Developer
profile.summary: I am a full stack developer with experiences in REST API technologies, in streaming data technology, in big data technologies, and in frontend technologies. With a Master Degree focused on Data Sciences, I have implemented several machine learning algorithms in the machine learning and Artificial Intelligence domains.

positions.title: Java Developer / SDET
positions.description: Automated mainframe applications with Robot Framework and BlueZone emulator.

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
Building REST API with Spring Boot, Swagger.
Using Drools as a Business Rule Management System.
Streaming data with Kafka.
Provisioning all the infrastructure resources in Amazon Web Services (AWS) RDS and AWS DMS environment by using AWS Cloud Formation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented web applications using  Java SE, JDBC, Servlet, Weblogic server, JUnit, Log4J, HTML, Bootstrap and Git.
Leveraged AWS S3 service to persist business data for ingestion into a AWS Redshift data warehouse for analytical processing.
Created distributed cluster with AWS EMR to run MapReduce jobs on a multi-node cluster.
Installed a pseudo-distributed cluster with Hadoop to run MapReduce jobs for solving big data problems.
